criteria.text: Build/install the final feature pack only into a dedicated temporary Hermes home/profile, exercise one fixture-backed planning cycle through dashboard, tasks, planner, rhythms, projects, messages, facilities, automations, integrations, artifacts, and exactly three native tools.

Create a machine-readable parity ledger containing fixture, canonical read, allowed-write confirmation, responsive/a11y, and failure-state evidence per module; reject credentials and unapproved writes.
Cover auth expiry, restart signal, profile switch/generation invalidation, update/reinstall/rollback/uninstall, performance budget, secret redaction, and uncertain writes.
Explicitly list policy-disabled actions and prove absent; preserve Electron code and agent navigation, with deletion only documented in a separate plan.

Where credentialed live reads cannot safely run, use the actual mounted backend transport against sanitized canonical fixtures and mark external credentialed live-read/manual evidence pending; keep AJ cutover/merge and signed/notarized release gates pending.
criteria.reason: Requires AJ-operated credentialed environment and release signing/notarization authority; the deterministic fixture transport is automated separately.
